a street cart snack for a New York winter

Chestnuts scored and roasted until the shells curl, peeled warm and tossed in sage brown butter with flaky salt, served in paper cones. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut a cross into the flat side of 500g chestnuts and soak them in water for 15 minutes. Roast on a tray for 20 to 25 minutes until the shells curl back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel while warm. Melt 40g butter in a pan with 6 sage leaves until it smells nutty, toss the chestnuts through, season with flaky salt and serve in paper cones.
M: Jenny's lemon and thyme roast chicken

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme, crunchy potatoes cooked in the drippings, buttered green beans and a quick pan gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and 6 thyme sprigs, rub with 30g soft butter and salt. Roast 20 minutes, then drop to 180C. Add 1kg peeled, quartered potatoes tossed in oil around the bird and roast another 50 minutes until the thigh juices run clear. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour and 300ml chicken stock into the pan juices for gravy. Boil 300g green beans 3 minutes and toss in butter.
Griddled franks in steamed buns with sauerkraut, mustard, onion and relish
Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with mustard, chopped onion, relish and warm sauerkraut.
W: Crisp butter cookies cut into cat shapes and iced
Shortbread dough rolled 6mm, cut into cat shapes, baked at 160C for 18 minutes, iced orange with little whiskers.
K: Whole milk warmed with honey, cinnamon and vanilla, no alcohol

Full cream milk warmed with honey, cinnamon and vanilla, frothed until foamy and dusted with nutmeg, served in mugs with a cinnamon stick. Pour 1 litre full cream milk into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Warm over medium heat for 5 minutes until steaming but not boiling. Remove the cinnamon stick and whisk hard or use a frother until foamy. Pour into 4 mugs, dust with a pinch of grated nutmeg and add a fresh cinnamon stick to each.

s.note: Sticky honey mustard cocktail franks on toothpicks
s.how: Simmer 24 cocktail franks for 5 minutes and drain. Toss in a hot pan with 2 tbsp Dijon and 2 tbsp honey for 3 minutes until sticky and glazed. Spear each on a toothpick and serve while hot.

s.note: Little fish-shaped cheddar crackers, crisp and salty, for snacking
s.how: Pulse 150g grated cheddar, 60g cold butter and 100g flour with a pinch of salt until it forms a dough, adding a splash of water. Roll thin, cut into little fish shapes and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

m.note: Griddled franks with mustard, onion, relish and sauerkraut
m.how: Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Warm 250g sauerkraut in a small pan. Steam 8 buns and fill with franks, mustard, chopped onion, sweet relish and the sauerkraut.

w.note: Cat-shaped shortbread iced orange with whiskers
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g icing sugar and mix in 350g flour. Roll to 6mm, cut into cat shapes and bake at 160C for 18 minutes. Ice with 200g icing sugar tinted orange and pipe on little whiskers in white.
